evidence_snippets: If there's no VMware host in the network, we recommend one of the following options to migrate your VMs to a source environment that Migrate to Virtual Machines supports: Migrate VMware VMs with VMware HCX to Google Cloud VMware Engine .

For example, if you migrate a database that supports a high volume of transactions per time unit, the speed at which the transactions are propagated to the target environment might not be fast enough to complete the synchronization.
If you need to migrate a workload that supports high volumes of transactions or requests, assess the speed at which changes are synchronized between the source and the target environments.
